correctness.rationale: The complex canonically splits into copies of one-degree spheres S_i (multiplicity h_i) and contractible two-degree disks D_i (multiplicity b_i). Direct chain-map equations give diagonal matrix semisimple factors M_(h_i) and M_(b_i), and radical Hom dimensions Σb_i(h_i+h_(i+1)+b_(i+1)). Commuting idempotents have exhaustive Boolean projectors P_sigma giving colored direct summands, so conjugacy is determined exactly by their indecomposable multiplicities and finite-field stabilizer ratio G_q(h,b)/∏G_q(h_sigma,b_sigma). Ranks on chain/homology/boundaries follow by summing each color. Characteristic-free decomposition holds, including zero multiplicities. Idempotent image ranks on homology and boundaries are locally constant in families, making each homogeneous orbit clopen in the reduced variety; G and stabilizers smooth connected, hence each orbit geometrically irreducible, with dimension difference. The affine unipotent quotient via polynomial (1+x)(1+y) factorization verifies the partial-flag fiber assertion. Independently enumerated 32 chain endomorphisms, 18 idempotents, and 196 commuting ordered pairs for F2 S0+S1+D0; exact tree hash independently reconstructed.
